_comment: Ticker store for NEPSE securities. Maps ticker symbols to their security_id and exchange_security_id

_instructions.security_id: Security ID used for placing orders
_instructions.exchange_security_id: Exchange security ID used for placing orders
_instructions.fetch_id: (Optional) Security ID used for fetching LTP. If not provided, uses security_id
_instructions.name: (Optional) Company name for reference
